Resolves #21598

Related: #21140, #21325, #21589, #21591, #21593

Phone viewports (`<= 640 px`) on `/examples` now share one `65 px` crumb row between the group switcher (`130.9 × 48 px` at `360–390 px`) and the find field (`197.1 px` at `360 px`, `227.1 px` at `390 px`, `459.6 px` at `639 px`), switch the intro lead to the concise two-line `phoneLead`, and keep `"Open the 100,000 × 200 grid"` and `"or the Workstation →"` unclipped on one `48 px` row across `360–640 px` — raising the first featured card's top from `587 px` (pre-`#21593`) / `570.3 px` (`0c672c2c92`) to **`401.1 px`** (`47.5 %` of `390 × 844`, showing two complete live example cards above the fold) while leaving `1440 × 900` unchanged.

Evidence: L3 (local Whitebox E2E red-on-`dev` / green-at-head + full-viewport dark-theme before/after frames at `390 × 844`, `360 × 800`, and `1440 × 900`) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-4 govern rendered phone/desktop layout). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #21140.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Action-row non-wrap root cause & single-row phone fit ([`#21598#issuecomment-7046551914`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21598#issuecomment-7046551914)):** `.portal-examples-overview-actions` (`Overview.mjs:104`, `wrap: 'wrap'`) never wrapped because `flex: 'none'` (`flex: 0 0 auto`) inside its parent `hbox` (`.portal-examples-overview-top`) lacked `max-width: 100%; min-width: 0`, sizing to `max-content` (`386.3 px`), while `Neo.button.Base` applied `--button-margin: 4px` and horizontal `--button-padding` around the underlined `"or the Workstation →"` link. Setting `max-width: 100%; min-width: 0` (so `< 360 px` screens wrap cleanly) and zeroing `--button-margin` + tertiary horizontal padding at `<= 640 px` keeps both actions unclipped on one `48 px` row at `360 × 800` (`16..340.3 px`) and `390 × 844` without altering link copy or burning `+58 px` on a second button row.
- **Single-line `"Start here  featured live demonstrations"` heading on phone:** Once `#21593` moved the build control below the featured cards on `<= 640 px`, the `flex-direction: column` override in `Overview.css` was obsolete; dropping it lets `"Start here  featured live demonstrations"` sit on one `24 px` baseline row (saving `18.8 px`) alongside `GroupPage.css`-aligned `14 px` phone top padding.
